products.name: Coda AI
products.note: All-in-one doc AI; automation; team data; enterprise governance features

reading.body:
Coda positions itself as a generalist workspace that consolidates documents, spreadsheets, applications, and AI into one tool, letting teams replace multiple specialized software with a single product.

The company's AI offering covers document generation, automation, team data management, and enterprise governance, all embedded in a collaborative interface. Coda's approach reflects a broader pattern in AI tooling: embedding AI capabilities into platforms teams already use rather than forcing adoption of standalone AI services. This matters for compute because consolidation into fewer, larger platforms creates fewer but denser workloads on backend infrastructure, and because automation features drive continuous API calls and data processing that scale with team size.

The available facts cover Coda's product positioning and feature set but contain no information about the company's infrastructure, data center locations, power consumption, training compute, or scaling plans. They also exclude financial data, leadership changes, or regulatory filings. The rebranding to Superhuman Docs signals product emphasis on human-AI collaboration, but the data does not clarify whether this represents a technical shift or a marketing one.

profile_text.body:
Coda describes itself as an all-in-one collaborative workspace, a platform that blends the flexibility of docs, the structure of spreadsheets, the power of applications, and the intelligence of AI. According to its site, anyone can design a time-saving solution using a formula, button, or automation, and replace niche apps in their tool stack. The site also states that Coda is now Superhuman Docs, which it describes as a name change that evolves Coda into a place for teams to collaborate with AI, alongside enterprise-ready databases and new AI Views.

The product tracked for the company is Coda AI, listed under notes, knowledge and meetings. It is described as an all-in-one doc AI with automation, team data, and enterprise governance features.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
